title: Monomorphism-Based CGRA Mapping Via Space and Time Decoupling
problem: CGRA compilation faces scalability challenges when mapping code onto large arrays due to combined space-time search complexity.
motivation: Energy-efficient accelerators require scalable compilation that can handle large CGRAs without excessive compile-time overhead.
method: Decouples spatial and temporal mapping dimensions via SMT formulation: SMT traverses time dimension first identifying feasible schedules, then monomorphism-based graph matching finds valid spatial assignments.
key_novelty: Time-space decoupling with monomorphism-based spatial search achieves dramatic compilation speedup for large CGRAs.
contributions: 105× average compilation speedup for 20×20 CGRA with comparable mapping quality
limitations: Evaluation limited to loop kernels; applicability to general control flow not discussed.
primary_theme: scalable CGRA compilation via time-space decoupling
